hooks.name: Monitor Live Trace on Session Start
hooks.description: Reads the last 50 lines of the server live_trace.log at session start so the agent immediately sees recent errors, API calls, and pipeline state without the user needing to paste anything.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path 'C:\Users\JohnM\My Applications\Kiro\CEO_Kiro\CEO_Attempt\output\live_trace.log') { Get-Content 'C:\Users\JohnM\My Applications\Kiro\CEO_Kiro\CEO_Attempt\output\live_trace.log' -Tail 50 } else { Write-Output 'No live_trace.log found' }"
